findings.claim: The Execute handoff is marked completed and points to Reflect while the active consistency change still has unfinished review work.
findings.evidence: The new execute handoff contains "completedAt" and "nextStage": "reflect" with "summaryForNext": "Start consistency 1.1; no implementation complete yet"; the same diff adds .kbd-orchestrator/phases/agent-team-creator/tasks.md showing kbd-consistency-before-agent-teams task 3.1 as "[ ] ... (IN_PROGRESS)" and openspec/changes/kbd-consistency-before-agent-teams/tasks.md showing 3.1 unchecked. Acceptance requires Execute → verification/adversarial review/archive → Reflect and task 3.1 is "Run deterministic QA and independent cumulative diff review, resolve findings, record correction ledger and commit."
findings.suggested_fix: Do not write an execute-stage completion handoff to Reflect until all Execute tasks, QA, independent review, verification/archive, and commit requirements for the change are complete; keep execution state as in-progress instead.

findings.claim: The diff mutates unrelated phase task history, violating the requirement to preserve unrelated work and canonical history for this consistency change.
findings.evidence: The diff changes integration-administration tasks from only pending tasks 1.1–2.5 to many completed tasks, e.g. 1.1 through 2.5 become "[x] ... (COMPLETE)" and new completed tasks 6.1 through 7.2 are added; acceptance proposal Impact says "Canonical history and unrelated work remain intact" and design Goals/Non-Goals says not to rewrite canonical events or reset earlier evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove unrelated phase progress/task projection changes from this change unless they are directly required and justified by the consistency spec; commit only the active phase/change projections needed for this work.

findings.claim: The change records deterministic checks as complete while explicitly leaving the mandatory independent review pending.
findings.evidence: consistency-verification.json sets "status": "deterministic-checks-complete-independent-review-pending" and "pending": ["Independent cumulative diff review"], while acceptance tasks.md task 3.1 requires "Run deterministic QA and independent cumulative diff review, resolve findings, record correction ledger and commit" before the consistency change is complete.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep task 3.1 and the change incomplete until the independent cumulative diff review is run and its findings are resolved or formally carried according to the KBD process.

findings.claim: The change adds large generated distribution skill references without corresponding source skill files in the diff, making the generated distribution difficult to verify for source/output sync.
findings.evidence: The diff adds new dist/plugins/claude and dist/plugins/codex rust-* skill files and references, including rust-best-practices chapter files, but the diff does not add corresponding source paths under skills/rust-*; C-01 requires generated artifacts to be in sync and forbids hand-editing generated outputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure the rust skill source directories are present and included in the change, then regenerate the distribution from source; if these dist files are not intended for this consistency change, remove them and leave generation to the named reconciliation task.
